applicability_caveats: g is a strong function of aggregate size (kRg), not a constant: fixed-g HG is a modelling choice; Pandey & Chakrabarty 2016 Opt.Lett. 41:3351 bound HG error at up to 35% in g/beta (<=8% in forcing)
RDG-FA validity: <=10% error for phase-shift parameter 2kRg|m-1|<1 (Sorensen p.668; Farias et al. 1995 JHT 117:152, open NIST copy - dominant error is m itself, not RDG-FA)
d_p young-soot range is lead-only; young/precursor soot is partially translucent (Koylu et al. 1997 CF 110:494) so TEM vs optical d_p diverge
G(kRg) Eq.35 is ~20% small at kRg>=10 (Kazakov-Frenklach via Sorensen p.655) - matters for largest overfire aggregates only

method: RDG-FA per Sorensen 2001 (Aerosol Sci. Tech. 35:648-687): sigma_abs^agg = N*sigma_abs^m (Eq.29); rho_sa = N*G(kRg)*(2/3)*x_p^3*(F/E) (equiv. Sorensen Eq.115 / Krishnan-Faeth Eq.17 - verified identical); G = Dobbins-Megaridis total-scattering factor (Eq.35); differential structure factor Dobbins-Megaridis (Guinier + power-law, value+slope-matched crossover at (qRg)^2=3Df/2, C~1) - Fisher-Burford and exponential forms explicitly REJECTED per Sorensen p.660 (C=2.44/2.73 at Df~1.8 over-predict large-angle scattering); g = <cos theta> over (1+cos^2)*S(q)
